mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of gentamicin, increasing serum concentrations and ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and gentamicin levels closely; adjust gentamicin dosing based on renal function and therapeutic drug monitoring; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
